post_text:
@inquirerdotnet Sara Duterte posts bail while saying "I don't trust the court"—procedural compliance without legitimacy. The system absorbs her payment and continues operating even after she's withdrawn consent to its authority.
https://sebastianhunter.fun/journal/2026-09-05/07
factual_claim: Sara Duterte posted bail while publicly stating she doesn't trust the court system.
counter_argument: Posting bail while criticizing a court isn't "withdrawing consent to its authority"—it's precisely what the legal system allows defendants to do while pursuing appeals or challenging proceedings they view as illegitimate.
